title: Workspace Standards
description: Shape of a repo's agent-orientation config. Scoped to STRUCTURE and POLICY METADATA only — never repo-specific prose. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md stay free-form Markdown on purpose (that's the actual AAIF spec for AGENTS.md: no required fields, any headings); this schema exists because nothing in the AGENTS.md/llms.txt/agent-manifest ecosystem covers 'what structural conventions should every repo in this personal workspace follow, and when was that policy last checked against current practice' — see docs/standards/RESEARCH_NOTES.md for the survey that confirmed the gap (2026-09-15).

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this schema. Bump minor when adding optional fields, major when changing required fields or semantics.

extends.description: Path (repo-relative, home-relative '~/...', or informational) to the workspace-level defaults instance this repo inherits from. Present only in per-repo instance files, absent in the workspace-level defaults file itself (dotfiles' own instance). A repo's own fields OVERRIDE the inherited value for that key; unset fields inherit as-is — same 'closer file wins' inheritance EditorConfig and GitHub's org-wide .github community-health-files both use.

repoRole.description: What kind of repo this is. 'archived' repos are exempt from validation and review (read-only, historical).

allowedFiles.description: Filenames permitted at repo root. Convention: README.md always; tool-convention entrypoints (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .clinerules) that a harness auto-loads only from root; .gitignore; scripts genuinely meant to be invoked from root.

docsDir.description: Where everything NOT auto-loaded by convention goes. Everything else at root is a hygiene violation.

canonical.description: Which root file is the source of truth when more than one exists. AGENTS.md is the cross-tool (AAIF-governed) standard read by 30+ tools; CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md are tool-specific and may be thin pointers to it, or carry genuinely tool-specific instructions (e.g. hook/skill notes that only make sense in Claude Code).

requiredSections.description: Section headings README.md must contain, checked by name (not exact wording). Established this session across 4 repos; not sourced from external SOTA (research 2026-09-15 found no formal README-for-agents standard) — this workspace's own convention.

note.description: Honesty flag: the 2026-09-15 research pass found NO established community/vendor convention recommending a diagram for agent-context-efficiency (Aider's repo-map and AGENTS.md's plain prose are the actual practiced patterns). This field exists because the workspace owner asked for it specifically, not because it's SOTA — keep it optional/low-priority relative to the prose sections above, and revisit if a future review still finds no supporting evidence.

language.description: technical = docs/code comments/commit messages. userFacing = content meant for the repo owner directly (this workspace's convention has been Portuguese).

suggestNewSessionWhen.description: Heuristics an agent should watch for to proactively suggest ending the current session and starting a fresh one, rather than the owner deciding this alone. Token-optimization rationale: resuming a long session (--resume/--continue) reloads its full history, which costs far more than starting fresh with a short, well-written kickoff prompt.

mustOfferKickoffPrompt.description: When suggesting a new session, the agent must hand back a short, copy-pasteable prompt to start that next session with (pointing at whatever persistent doc/file carries the state — e.g. CHEATSHEET.md, a tasks/ tracker, a kickoff file), not just say 'you should start a new session.'

cadenceDays.description: How often (in days) this config should be re-checked against current community/vendor practice. Modeled on Renovate's schedule field — this is a personal workspace, not a package registry, so a coarse cadence (weekly-ish) is the right grain, not Renovate's cron precision.

sourcesToRecheck.description: What to re-verify each cycle: is AGENTS.md still schema-free per AAIF, has anything new emerged in the agent-workspace-config space, are the required README sections still the right ones.

onDrift.description: Renovate-style: propose a diff for human review, never auto-commit changes to policy.
